text:
Priya: Heads-up 1: our hiring team flagged 6 offer packets today missing interviewer scorecards. noticed when trying to share with GC.
Sam: that's bad. which pipeline step?
Elena: Offer generator webhook `offer-assemble-v1` didn't attach `scorecards` array for candidates moved to `offer_accepted` between 06:40-07:15 UTC.
recruiter-bot: [automated] created ticket RECR-4955: missing-attachments-in-offer-packet. sample payload: `{candidate_id:C-9921,attachments:[]}`
Nora: did any deploys touch the attachment service last night?
Priya: ops ran a blobstore upgrade; PR #3572 touched the S3 key normalization.
Sam: quick mitigation: we've paused auto-issue of offer emails and flipped `offer_packet_send=false` in prod at 07:38 UTC.
Elena: running a db query to list impacted offers: `SELECT id FROM offers WHERE created_ts BETWEEN 2187650400 AND 2187652000 AND attachments_count=0;`
Priya: Legal wants affected packets gathered before we re-send. can we backfill attachments from scorecard_submissions table?
Elena: yes, backfill script in progress. mapping logic: join offers.candidate_id -> scorecard_submissions.candidate_id and attach latest 3.
recruiter-bot: [automated] backfill queued for 6 offers, ETA 15m.
Sam: postmortem items: 1) revert normalization change or add compatibility shim (Elena) 2) verify backfill + resend with audit (Priya) 3) add deploy check to block S3 key changes (Nora).
Elena: patch merged to add shim (PR #3578) and deploy scheduled 08:10 UTC.
Priya: legal acknowledged, will hold final sends until we confirm attachments present.
Nora: added alert if `offers` created without attachments >1 in 10m.
Sam: thanks team. keep thread updated when backfill completes.
recruiter-bot: [automated] backfill completed at 08:02 UTC; attachments restored for offers [O-1201,O-1203,O-1207,O-1210,O-1212,O-1218].
Priya: confirmed with Legal; packets OK. resuming offer sends at 08:20 UTC. closing RECR-4955 once postmortem is up. :+1:
